description_en: Queries the information about the historical versions of a service
kebab_example: aliyun eas list-service-versions --cluster-id cn-hangzhou --service-name test_oss --page-number 1 --page-size 10 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListServiceVersions

parameters.help_en: The ID of the region in which the service resides
parameters.name: cluster_id

parameters.help_en: The service name. For more information about how to query the service name, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/412109.html
parameters.help_zh: 服务名称。如何获取服务名称，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/412109.html
parameters.name: service_name

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page. Default value: 100
parameters.help_zh: 分页查询时设置的每页显示的版本数量，默认为100
parameters.name: page_size
